digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer discovery
propositions: Repo-less CLI clients cannot resolve internal cross-references in packaged guides because links use consumer-relative paths instead of canonical hosted URLs or rebar explain topics
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) lacks a CLI-discoverable first-class home; only rebar verify-commit-ticket --help documents it
Packaged author guides must use only allowed link targets: https://, http://, intra-doc anchors (#), or rebar explain <topic> references; all consumer-relative paths must be converted to hosted URLs
A link-resolution guard test must verify all packaged guides and explain_criterion renderings contain no consumer-relative paths and all rebar explain references name real registered guides
The commit-trailer guide must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES registry and added to MCP explain_criterion docstring for full discovery parity with plan and review guides
